name: Sultan
about: The boss of the yard. Copper neck feathers and a dark green tail. Always first to crow and last to roost.

name: Chintu
about: The easiest one to spot on camera: all white with a big floppy comb. Crows whenever Sultan does, slightly off-key.

name: Kalu
about: Jet black from beak to toes. Quiet most of the day, then very loud around sunset.
